member.summary:
Default implementation. Every method opens a short-lived , executes a single fully-parameterised query, and materialises the rows via Dapper's column dictionary binding. The connection string is built from the agent's so secrets never appear in this class.
All three SQL statements use the canonical Mikro form:
SELECT TOP N … JOIN _ERPB_SENKRONIZASYON … Islem = 2 for inserted rows.
SELECT TOP N t.<fields>, s.TriggerRECno FROM T JOIN _ERPB_SENKRONIZASYON s ON … WHERE s.TriggerRECno > @cursor AND s.TabloID = @tabloId AND s.Islem = 1 ORDER BY s.TriggerRECno for changed rows.
SELECT KayitRECno, TriggerRECno FROM _ERPB_SENKRONIZASYON WHERE TriggerRECno > @cursor AND TabloID = @tabloId AND Islem = 0 ORDER BY TriggerRECno for deleted rows.
Field names are validated against before any SQL is generated so a typo in a caller's field list cannot turn into an SQL-injection surface.

DDL constants and DDL bodies for the FORA-compatible change-tracking tables and triggers. Faz 15 replaces the legacy _ERPB_SENKRONIZASYON (with its single AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE trigger and the Islem column) with two parallel shadow tables — _ERPB_SYNC for INSERT/UPDATE and _ERPB_SYNC_DEL for DELETE — mirroring the reference app's _FORA_SYNC / _FORA_SYNC_DEL pair.
